body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> San Disk presented its first widescreen PMP ‘Sansa View’ during CES 2007.

This flash-based PMP supports a wide array of content formats and comes equipped with a flash memory expansion slot. With 4-inch widescreen, it can display photos(up to 16megapixels), play music or combine the two in a slideshow format.

According to the company, it features 8GB internal flash memory to store up to 33 video hours or 2,000 songs, or thousands of photos, internal speaker, and flash memory expansion card slot compatible with SD, SDHC, and others.
The Sansa View works with Windows media player 10 or 11 for syncing of content, and is designed to work with windows Vista.
It is expected to be available in the US in Q1 of 2007 with suggested retail price of MSRP 299(USD).
